last_completed_unit.target: Cargo build-script override via target.<triple>.<links> configuration
last_completed_unit.finding: Official Cargo documentation states that for a package declaring a links key, a matching target-specific links configuration can override the package build script; Cargo then does not compile or run that build script and instead uses the supplied metadata. The mechanism is bounded to the matching links-declaring package/target and does not establish universal build.rs suppression.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Package manifest declares links=foo and matching [target.<triple>.foo] config supplies replacement metadata for the active target.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Packages without links, correctness/completeness of substituted metadata, build-script side effects not represented by metadata, actual scheduled-Chat Cargo/rustc execution, end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main identity, and exactly one official Cargo documentation page/section: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/reference/build-scripts.html#overriding-build-scripts.
scope_guard: Do not broaden target.<triple>.<links> build-script override into universal dependency build-script disabling or end-to-end Chat-native Rust build parity.

frontier.current_target: Determine whether a Cargo-native mechanism exists for dependency packages without a links key, or whether that class remains a hard build-script-execution blocker.
frontier.next_unit: After fresh required-control bootstrap and SHA-only freshness validation, inspect exactly one official Cargo documentation page or section about package.build / build-script disabling semantics. Test only whether dependency packages without a links key can have build.rs execution disabled by consumer-side manifest/config without editing upstream package sources.

exact_continuation: On the next invocation, fresh-bootstrap and freeze current authority, then inspect exactly one official Cargo documentation page or section describing package.build or build-script disabling. Determine only whether a consumer can disable build.rs for a dependency package that lacks links, without modifying that dependency's source; record exact scope and semantic limitations, and do not attempt actual Cargo execution.
